ns2:course.label: Seminar in Music Education
ns2:course.description: Seminar for students preparing to enter student teaching. Students should enroll in the semester prior to student teaching. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: Music education majors or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Approved for both letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: Music education majors or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionCappArea: Restricted to Admitted Teacher Ed Student students.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: For seniors in music education who will student teach in the spring.
